question: Does a further official 2012 Jiangsu government gazette index or a Nanjing University 1608 Zhang Chongli 40-fascicle catalogue locator promote Yangzhou/Wuxi juan45 to authenticated original evidence or prove a print-stemma relation?

sources.provider: 江苏省人民政府政府公报
sources.direct_claim: 2012年第二十三期政府公报目录省政府文件一栏明确列有《省政府关于公布第三批江苏省珍贵古籍名录的通知》并链接到 art_46746_2649485.html.
sources.limit: The issue index authenticates publication within an official gazette but neither the 249-row appendix nor item 02273 is displayed on this index page.

sources.provider: 江苏省人民政府政府公报
sources.direct_claim: Official issue23 index links this article URL, but the document viewer returned Fetch denied by robots.txt for the direct target.
sources.limit: Official link existence and document title are verified; the article content and individual 02273 row cannot be cited as directly collated official text.

sources.direct_claim: Independent official government notice verifies 苏政发〔2012〕86号, approval of 249 items and links an original .doc appendix.
sources.limit: The .doc target has application/msword content type unsupported by the web reading channel. An attempted separate download failed; no file bytes or line-level government appendix evidence was acquired.

sources.provider: 法搜再版页面（非江苏省政府）
sources.direct_claim: The reproduced row reads 02273 古今律历考七十二卷 （明）邢云路撰 明万历二十七年（1599）徐安刻本（有补配） 扬州市图书馆.
sources.limit: The original government appendix item row remains uncollated; supplementation leaf scope and juan45 survival unverified.

sources.provider: 国学大师古籍馆藏线索（非南京大学一方）
sources.direct_claim: Lists 《古今律歷考:72卷》 attributed to (明)邢雲路編, 明萬歷戊申[1608]張崇禮刻本, 40冊, holding 南京大學圖書館.
sources.limit: No Nanjing University library item ID, call number, physical edition description or printed juan45 leaf is reproduced; cannot treat it as a confirmed distinct block or numerical witness.

sources.direct_claim: The 南雍撷珍 first-party page reports near 30,000 ancient-book catalogue entries with anonymous catalogue lookup and requires campus unified login for image viewing.
sources.limit: Its public landing page does not itself identify any Xing item; catalogue web app at gjtc.nju.edu.cn returned no static searchable item content through the text reader. No login or credential workflow was attempted.

sources.direct_claim: Wuxi Library item02911 directly lists Ming1608 张崇礼/王国桢 72 juan, as in 13VT.
sources.limit: No surviving-juan count, Wuxi exact shelfmark or original target page.

sources.direct_claim: Book no06273 is catalogued Ming1608 孫瑋保定刊本, 20 fascicles and 9×18 text layout; prior 13UT/13VE already bound native original glyph loci.
sources.limit: Shared imprint year does not equate Wuxi Zhang/Wang, candidate NJU Zhang 40 fascicles and NCL Sun Wei plates or demonstrate print independence.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Official 2012 gazette table-of-contents listing is not direct proof of the secondary reproduced Yangzhou 02273 line, and its reported 1599 print with supplemented leaves is not a physical original-juan45 target until leaves are identified.

Nanjing University secondary 1608 Zhang 40-fascicle holding cannot be equated to Wuxi Zhang/Wang 1608 or NCL Sun Wei 1608 print blocks, or counted as independent reading merely because the catalogue printer and book counts differ.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Obtain openly readable first-party 2012 Yangzhou 02273 item text and supplement volume/leaf scope.
Resolve Nanjing University 1608 Zhang candidate to first-party item/call number and source-original juan45 only through authorized public access.
Independently read Xu-An L132 二/三 and source-native 疾 constructor/radix/carry, not via backwards computation.

next_action: Maintain original Xu-An juan45 L132 and 疾 constructor as top priority (Zhejiang 善002648, NCL06270, SYSU, existing NLC source families). Revisit Nanjing University item only if anonymously exposed catalogue record establishes real holding and juan45 survival; do not request login. Yangzhou row02273 remains secondary pending original appendix. No algorithm changes.
